gallery.theme_policy: One transparent asset per layout; identical molecular colors in light and dark mode. No embedded labels or titles.

conditioning_note: Coordinate conditioning supplies a reference; it does not freeze sampled coordinates. These renders are illustrative model outputs, not experimental validation.

animation.playback: Forward generation (8 s), endpoint hold (2 s), reverse replay (8 s). Reverse is presentation playback, not another model run.
animation.coordinate_policy: Exact discrete native states; no molecular interpolation. The supplied structure is not substituted for the generated endpoint.
